meanings.usage: 指两山之间的低洼地带
指较小的山或高地，复数形式为hills
指自然流动的水道，通常流入海洋或湖泊
指存放货币的金融机构

meanings.meaning: 堤岸（指河流两侧的陆地） noun. 银行

meanings.usage: 表示两物的相邻位置关系
表示从一边到另一边的动作
指任何有顶盖和墙壁的结构

meanings.meaning: 公园（指供公众休闲的绿地场所） verb. 停放（车辆）

meanings.usage: 指在水中移动的动作，现在分词为swimming
表示沿着某条线或边缘移动

examples.en: Our village is in a valley.
The village is on a river.

phrases.phrase: along the banks of the river

examples.en: We are walking along the banks of the river.
He is swimming across the river.
Some children are coming out of the building.
examples.zh: 一些孩子正从楼里出来。

phrases.usage: 表示进入...，与come out of相对

examples.en: Some of them are going into the park.
examples.zh: 他们中的一些人正走进公园。

examples.en: Here is another photograph of the village.
examples.zh: 这是我们村庄的又一张照片。

grammar.title: 现在进行时 (Present Continuous Tense)
grammar.structure: 主语 + is/am/are + 动词-ing形式
grammar.definition: 表示正在进行的动作或发生的事情 用于描述说话时正在发生的动作，或在描述一系列同时发生的动作时使用

examples.en: My wife and I are walking along the banks of the river.
examples.zh: 我和妻子正沿着河岸走。

examples.en: He is swimming across the river.
Some children are coming out of the building.
examples.zh: 一些孩子正从楼里出来。

grammar.title: 地点介词 (Prepositions of Place)
grammar.structure: in（在...里面）/ on（在...上面）/ between（在...之间）/ beside（在...旁边）
grammar.definition: 用于表示事物位置关系的介词 描述某人或某物所在的具体位置

examples.en: Our village is in a valley.
The park is on the right.

grammar.title: Here is/are... 句型
grammar.definition: 用于介绍或展示某物的句型 在对话或叙述中引出新的信息或展示某物

examples.en: Here is another photograph of the village.
examples.zh: 这是我们村庄的又一张照片。

patterns.pattern: 主语 + is/are + 动词-ing + 地点/方向

original.en: He is swimming across the river.

imitations.en: They are walking along the street.
The children are playing in the park.
imitations.zh: 孩子们正在公园里玩耍。

original.en: Here is another photograph of the village.
original.zh: 这是我们村庄的又一张照片。

imitations.en: Here are some books for you.

patterns.pattern: 主语 + is/are + 介词短语

original.en: Our village is in a valley.

imitations.en: The school is beside a park.
The store is between two buildings.
imitations.zh: 那家商店在两栋建筑物之间。

patterns.pattern: Some... are doing... Some... are doing...

original.en: Some children are coming out of the building. Some of them are going into the park.
original.zh: 一些孩子正从楼里出来。他们中的一些人正走进公园。

imitations.en: Some students are reading. Some of them are writing.
imitations.zh: 一些学生在读书。他们中的一些人在写字。

imitations.en: Some people are standing. Some of them are sitting.
imitations.zh: 一些人站着。他们中的一些人坐着。

translations.35:
这是我们村庄的一张照片。
我们的村庄坐落在一个山谷之中。
它们于两座小山之间。
它靠近一条小河。
这是我们村庄的另一张照片。
我和妻子沿河岸走着。
我们在河的左侧。
河里面有个男孩。
他正横渡小河。
这是另一张照片。
这是学校大楼。
它位于公园的旁边。
公园在右面。
一些孩子正从楼里出来。
他们中有几个正走进公园。

lines.en: This is a photograph of our village.
Our village is in a valley.
The village is on a river.
Here is another photograph of the village.
My wife and I are walking along the banks of the river.
There is a boy in the water.
He is swimming across the river.
The park is on the right.
Some children are coming out of the building.
Some of them are going into the park.

lead.summary: 这是我们村庄的一张照片。 我们的村庄坐落在一个山谷之中。语法聚焦：beside a park，位于公园旁边。。
lead.tips: 语法重点：beside a park，位于公园旁边。。重点词汇：photograph、village、valley 等，结合课文例句记忆。练法：先盲听跟读，再对照参考译文理解，最后尝试复述课文。
lead.question: Are the children coming out of the park or going into it? 孩子们是正从公园里出来还正在往里走？
